subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this issue require both Control UI and native WebChat URL linkification before it can close, or should it be narrowed to Control UI with native parity tracked separately?
rationale: The Control UI fix shape is clear, but the issue title and body also name WebChat; automation should not decide whether a web-only implementation satisfies the broader request.

options.title: Narrow to Control UI first
options.body: Implement and prove the complete Control UI tool-output path now, then split native WebChat parity into a follow-up if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Require full parity
options.body: Keep this issue open until both Control UI and native WebChat render safe clickable links in tool output.

options.title: Treat WebChat as out of scope
options.body: Make this request explicitly web-only and close it only after the Control UI behavior is implemented and proven.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Control UI first
recommendation.body: Implement and prove the complete Control UI tool-output path now, then split native WebChat parity into a follow-up if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already made the scope call in the prior review and is the clearest routing owner for whether native WebChat remains in scope.
